[[File:Kevin Martilla DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Kevin Martilla at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Kevin Martilla''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 78 FL from San Antonio, Tx. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

A U.S. Air Force captain, he was a finalist at the 1998 and 1999 [[Star Trek CCG]] World Championships.<ref name="decsq-prof" /><ref name="stfield" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Martilla playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001).
